verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents integrations with major monitoring tools (Datadog, New Relic, Grafana, Prometheus, Zabbix, cloud providers) and lets teams build custom escalation policies that define who is alerted and in what order based on time, team availability, and incident origin, with on-call schedules and API tokens for programmatic control. This directly matches ingestion-plus-routing for SREs, though the evidence is first-party docs only. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of routing behavior, and explicit documentation of generic webhook/API ingestion from arbitrary/custom monitoring sources beyond the named integrations.
